title: The three lines and their poles are the creation myth: Wuji, Taiji, Yin/Yang, the eight images (2026-10-25)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Let's build a cannonical definition of our three axes. We will keep refining it. But the three lines and their poles are our core practice. They are the creation myth. 

Wuji 
Taiji
Yin/Yang
And the 8 images. 

This is the systems science 
It's the cybernetics

Our whole boundary and tension practice is applied everywhere from the same rules
